description: Header file defining the VisualStudioWriter class and related structures for generating Visual Studio project and solution files within a build system.

classes.name: VisualStudioWriter
classes.description: Class responsible for generating Visual Studio project and solution files based on build system targets.

classes.name: SolutionEntry
classes.description: Represents a solution folder or project in the Visual Studio solution structure.

classes.name: SolutionProject
classes.description: Represents a Visual Studio project within the solution, inheriting from SolutionEntry.

classes.name: SourceFileCompileTypePair
classes.description: Associates a source file with its compile type for project generation.

methods.name: RunAndWriteFiles
methods.description: Static method to generate Visual Studio project and solution files based on build settings, target filters, and SDK version.

methods.name: ResolveSolutionFolders
methods.description: Resolves and organizes solution folders and updates project parent relationships.

methods.name: GetNinjaTarget
methods.description: Returns the ninja build target string and whether it is a phony target.
